100 Stories for Queensland

An anthology for charity

Title: 100 Stories for Queensland
Author: Various

Publication Date: 3 May 2011
Publisher: eMergent Publishing
ISBN13: 978-0-9871126-3-7 (ebook) and 978-0-9871126-2-0 (pbk)
Edition: 1st
Genre: Anthology, General
Formats: paperback, epub, mobi, pdf
Pages: 316

Description

100 STORIES FOR QUEENSLAND has something for everyone, from slice of life to science fiction, fantasy to romance, paranormal to literary fiction. Heart-warming, quirky, inspiring and funny the stories between these covers will lift readers to higher ground.

100 Stories for Queensland is a charity anthology to assist the victims of the Queensland floods. Stories are donated by writers from across the globe and includes my story “Amunet’s Gift”.

100% of the profit from the sale of the anthology will be donated to the Queensland Premier’s Flood Relief Appeal.

Available from

This book is out of print and is no longer available for purchase.

Reviews:

“One hundred beautiful stories. Our stories. When so much was lost or destroyed, this was created. That’s something that can never recede or wash away.” Kate Eltham, CEO of The Queensland Writers Centre

Karen Field’s ‘Amunet’s Gift’ is very sweet. It has great visual imagery. Jo Hart, The Graceful Doe Blog
